pages.title: Fractal Dust
pages.text: Grit with the same structure at every scale: each grain is made of smaller grains arranged exactly like the whole pile. Its dimension is not a whole number, somewhere between a scattering of points and a line. It sifts strangely, never quite settling, as if there is always more of it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first handful came from a Fractal Wyrm I had cut down in the Platonic Realm, and from shelves in the old vaults. Later I learned to shave it from fractal lattice blocks with the Planck-Scale Cutter, helium keeping the cuts clean.

Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Fractal Ore$(), in veins through the Platonic Realm.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Fractal Wyrm.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Euclids Vault, Hilbert Archive chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Platonic Realm.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Empirical Notes I, Fractal Core, Fractal Set.
